title: First heap block gate
statement: Let $n,k,q\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$. If $1\le q<2^{n-k+1}$, then the gate at index $n+(q-1)$ in the construction for $f$ and parameter $k$ is the heap gate with parameters $n$, base $2n$, offset $0$, and size $q$.
